title: Gryphon Wing / Trap Jammer — isolated TagDuel counter-response adapter

cards.name: Gryphon Wing
cards.officialText: When your opponent activates Harpie's Feather Duster: Negate its effect, and if you do, destroy all Spells and Traps your opponent controls.

behavior.destroys: all opposing Spell/Trap cards including Field Zone

cards.name: Trap Jammer
cards.officialText: When your opponent activates a Trap Card during the Battle Phase: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

implementation.mode: isolated; not wired into tagActions, tagInteraction or Discord
implementation.rootPendingHfd: separate pending EFFECT-negation flag; does not misuse pendingNegated (activation negation)
implementation.physicalOwnership: UID m0..m3 preserved; partner can activate shared backrow; cards return to physical owner's team Graveyard
implementation.inventory: Only zone movement; before/after UID+ID map invariant. The isolated HFD fixture opens a real response window with an already-admitted Magic Jammer, then swaps only that fixture card's ID to Gryphon Wing; the Trap Jammer fixture keeps a separate Magic Jammer set. No live inventory or player data is granted.

invariants.hand: 6-card limit at End Phase; no early discard or hand mutation

limitations: Not wired into authoritative resolver or Discord action menus.
Root-pending HFD effect negation needs a distinct pending-effect-negated field in the central engine before production integration.
No live Discord gateway/session used; tests exercise actual TagDuel HFD and Mirror Force transitions plus isolated response adapter.
tests: HFD response window is held open by a certified Magic Jammer before the fixture substitutes Gryphon Wing
